program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((seed (first-colored-cell g))
         (seed-row (first seed))
         (seed-col (second seed))
         (color (at g seed-row seed-col)))
    (grid-from-fn
      (rows g)
      (cols g)
      (lambda (row col)
        (if (or (= row seed-row) (= col seed-col))
            color
            0)))))
